CustomField.description: When checked, the email alert is sent to the user who originally submitted the record for approval (CustomApproval__c.SubmittedBy__c). Used only when ActionKind__c = EmailAlert.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sends to the user who clicked Submit for Approval. Useful for FinalApproval, FinalRejection, and Recall notifications so the submitter is informed of the outcome.
CustomField.label: Notify Submitter
